pages.title: A loose heel · 1/3
paragraphs: Rosa has a pair of old leather boots. One heel is loose, and she cannot walk well. She finds a tiny shoe repair shop in Seattle. The shop smells like leather and polish. An old man named Hank wears a brown apron. He puts the boots on the table and looks at them.
“Good morning! What do you have there?” says Hank. “These boots. The heel is loose.” says Rosa. “I see. I can fix it today.” says Hank.
